in_marathi.name: Balmiki
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balmiki हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balmiki is a revered sage and poet in Hindu mythology. He is believed to be the author of the epic Ramayana. The name Balmiki means 'great scribe' or 'learned scholar'.

in_bengali.name: Balmiki
